channel.title: The Wilson Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Wilson Times (wilsontimes.com)

item.title: AREA ROUNDUP: Bruins bash Southern Wayne a second time
item.description: Beddingfield softball pounds Southern Wayne for 55 runs in two wins, Southern Nash’s Noel Dobbins powers 12-0 romp over Nash Central, while Bruins baseball drops second straight to Saints.

item.title: Second All City Classic to showcase Wilson hoops talent, raise funds
item.description: Wilson County’s second All City Classic, March 21-22 at Beddingfield High, will unite middle and high school hoopers while raising funds for local youth initiatives.

item.title: Church circle donates to Barton FCA
item.description: Barton College representatives of the FCA spoke at a Joyful Hands Circle gathering.

item.title: Loftin, Greene power Demons past Stallions to state 5-A title game
item.description: Jamir Loftin’s 40 points and Daquavis Greene’s double-double lift Fike past top-seeded Southeastern Alamance 84-77, sending the Demons to their first 5-A boys state title game since 1990.

item.title: No. 1 Duke deflates No. 17 UNC’s hopes of another upset
item.description: No. 1 Duke avenged its Chapel Hill loss, beating No. 17 UNC 76-61 behind Cameron Boozer’s 26-point double-double and Maliq Brown’s career night to cap a 29-2 regular season and secure the ACC’s top seed.

item.title: Chowan ousts Barton women from CC semifinals, 80-60
item.description: Chowan used a fast start and dominant rebounding to eliminate second-seeded Barton 80-60 in the Conference Carolinas semifinals, led by Yasmine Brown’s 27 points, and advance to face Lees-McRae in the title game.

item.title: Home demolition temporarily halted
item.description: Wilson has paused demolition of former city employee Lu-Ann Monson’s 1893 home while the council considers revisiting the demolition order at a March 19 meeting.

item.title: 'Turn a new corner': Council briefed on plans for Vick Cemetery
item.description: Wilson leaders outlined steps to safeguard 112-year-old Vick Cemetery, including halting excavation, expanded grave surveys and a proposed descendant-led oversight committee.

item.title: Wilson steps back in time for Renaissance Faire
item.description: Wilson’s Renaissance Faire brought medieval flair downtown over the weekend, with costumed attendees and period-themed activities in downtown Wilson.

item.title: Area Calendar, March 9-10, 2026
item.description: Area sports calendar for March 9-10: college golf, volleyball, softball and lacrosse, plus a full slate of local high school baseball, softball, soccer, tennis, track, golf and JV action.
